text:
Olivia: Quick FYI — proposing we enable the INT4 precision gate for sherpa-v2-small for a tiny audience slice tomorrow morning. Want to coordinate owners and checklist here.

Miguel: +1. What's the exact flag name and audience slice? Also who runs the smoke window?

Olivia: Flag: `precision_profile.sherpa_v2.int4_enabled`
Audience: org-level rollout by percentage (we'll start at 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50%)
Smoke window owner: Miguel you ok to watch first 30m? Asha can take the 2% step.

Asha: I can take the 2% -> 10% step. Will be on-call during the 10:00–12:00 PT window.

Sam: Posting quick checklist here. Please ack if anything missing.

- PR merged and green: https://git.internal/repo/pull/3421 :white_check_mark:
- Canary config in feature-store: `audience.slice=small_int4_test` :white_check_mark:
- Load test run against int4 runtime for 512 tokens: `k6` script done, no OOMs :white_check_mark:
- Observability: dashboards pinned (latency, error-rate, output-regressions) — link: https://dashboards.internal/r/redwood/sherpa-int4
- Alerts: create temporary alerts for p95 latency +10% threshold, error-rate +0.5% absolute, quality-regression A/B checker >2% failure

Miguel: One ask — can we add an eval set quick A/B (50k prompts) to watch hallucination/perplexity delta? I can run a fast offline compare and upload results before we move to 10%.

Olivia: Yes please. Target metrics to compare: rouge/bleu variants we use, and the new
